name: Simplo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Simplo Technology Co., Ltd. research, designs, and manufactures lithium battery modules in the Taiwan, China, the United States, and Singapore. It offers machine parts, such as plastic parts, die cut, film, and bus bar products series. The company offers its products for household appliances; and mobile devices, LEV, and EV applications, as well as for fit accessories. It engages in manufactures information software services, lighting equipment, data storage and processing equipment, electronic components, batteries, power generation, transmission and distribution machinery, and wireless communication machinery and equipment.
